title: 全球金融架构改革呼声再起 发展中国家债务负担成焦点
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: My question is, what initiatives will you implement to advance meaningful reform of the
segments.zh: 我的问题是，您将采取哪些举措来推动全球金融架构的有意义改革？

segments.en: global financial architecture, including address the bad debt burden, as well as operationalizing the severe commitment so that the global south can access development financing on a just
segments.zh: 包括解决债务负担问题，以及落实相关承诺，使全球南方能以公正平等的条件获得发展融资。
非常感谢，津巴布韦大使。正如我之前所说，将启动全球讨论以改革国际金融架构。

segments.en: Thank you very much, Rex and C. Ambassador from Zimbabwe. As I said earlier, global discussion will be launched to reform the international financial architecture.
segments.zh: 我们都看到债务负担，对发展中国家而言，问题不在于债务规模，而在于债务条件。
